title: CSV rerun destination validation
summary: CSV rerun final-output overrides are now validated against the effective configured output root or matching library-profile output root in backend preview/promote and PowerShell execution paths. Nested rerun temp configs force DeferredPublish=false so final placement remains under rerun destination policy.
reason: CSV rerun destination fields could previously carry outside-root final targets into rerun planning, pending-publish manifests, or promote flows. Rerun temp configs also inherited DeferredPublish, allowing nested publish behavior to bypass the rerun wrapper's destination handling.
behavior_before: CSV final-output override fields such as plex_planned_path and server_out were accepted without proving they were under the configured output root or library-profile output root; nested rerun configs could inherit DeferredPublish=true.
behavior_after: Backend preview/promote and PowerShell rerun planning reject outside-root final-output and sidecar destinations unless the confirmed same-file source-overwrite exception applies. Rerun temp configs explicitly set DeferredPublish=false.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths <touched rerun files> - passed (7 written, 1 unchanged)
rollback_plan: Revert the touched rerun policy, preview/promote, PowerShell entrypoint, tests, generated summaries, and this change packet. Re-run the targeted Python and PowerShell rerun/pending-publish validation commands before restoring release readiness.
